html:
Ireland is the state that covers most of the island of Ireland, with Dublin as its capital. On the map it appears from 1938, after it left the United Kingdom.

The Easter Rising of 1916 and the war of independence that followed led to the Anglo-Irish Treaty and the Irish Free State in 1922, a self governing dominion of the British Empire. Six northeastern counties stayed in the United Kingdom as Northern Ireland. A short civil war split the nationalists over the treaty.

Éamon de Valera led the country for much of the next decades. His constitution of 1937 renamed the state Ireland. It stayed neutral in the Second World War and became a republic outside the Commonwealth in 1949. Poor and losing people to emigration, as it had been since the Great Famine, it joined the European Community in 1973 and grew rich in the 1990s. The Good Friday Agreement of 1998 helped end the conflict in Northern Ireland.
sum: Ireland is the state that covers most of the island of Ireland, with Dublin as its capital. On the map it appears from 1938, after it left the United Kingdom.
